tool.name: Search Connector Actions
tool.description: Search and list endpoint names from a connector template. Returns a lightweight catalog of endpoint names and optional descriptions without full definitions. Supports pagination and search. Saves significant context tokens compared to fetching the full template.

connectorId.description: The connector template ID or slug

includeDescriptions.description: Whether to include endpoint descriptions in the list (default: false)

nodes.name: List Template Actions
nodes.description: Fetch the connector template actions with pagination and search

nodes.name: List Endpoints
nodes.description: Extract endpoint names and optional descriptions from the template with pagination metadata

nodes.name: End
nodes.description: Return the result with pagination metadata
